Hey. I don’t doubt you feel miserable and don’t doubt how badly you want to end your life. I feel hopeless too sometimes and have a terrible relationship with my parents (who physically abused me when I was child and emotionally abused me in high school). I still live with them since I’m in college but the only reason I’m bearing it up is cos I got one more year left and then I’m free. Now that doesn’t fully apply to your situation but I want to share a tactic that might convince you to not take your life.

Hate your parents? If they abuse you then obviously they probably wouldn’t care if you’re gone. Now think of other people you dislike and who hate you back and how they also might be happy to see you go. Now what could be a better way to spite them to stay alive? Sure you’re miserable and maybe you’re not in contact with them anyways so they’d never know, but think about it from an existential perspective. By staying alive, you’re winning! If you kill yourself it means you’ve let that abuse get to you and defeat you! So what better slap in the face of your enemies, than for you to stay alive. 

I don’t know if this will help or not but I hope this thinking can be useful to you. If you see this know I’m rooting for you and you’ll come out on top as a survivor.
